extraction.Name: Rosa Allman-nee Shangreau
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee and refused to take it, but that she was told, by the Farmer, and the Superintendent, that if she did not take the patent and pay the taxes that she would lose the land
extraction.Recorded patent: she did not have the patent recorded and does not know who did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to Harry J. Evans, Pine Ridge, So. Dak. for $800.00. This was about 1920.
extraction.Buyer: Harry J. Evans, Pine Ridge, So. Dak. for $800.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes on her land so she sold it
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in very poor health; husband also in very poor health; has 11 children, eight being minors, depending on her and her husband for support; has no home and is having a very hard time living; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was issued; document sworn November 13, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
